en: Collage-style, green-tinted postcard with three vignette views labeled in German: the city Concert House facade, St. Nicholas Church with a dome and spires, and the ornate Villa Schuller. Decorative floral border and a handwritten German note on the image. Publisher credit on the left margin. The reverse is a Hungarian-address format 'LEVELEZŐ-LAP' with a Magyar Kir. Posta 4-filler stamp and a Brassó postmark, addressed to Kronstadt.
